_readme: Real consensus genotypes transcribed from published GeT-RM (Genetic Testing Reference Materials Coordination Program) collaborative studies -- not fabricated. Verify against the primary source table before relying on these for anything beyond a smoke test, since transcription from PDF/HTML sources carries some risk of error. Only CYP2D6 entries are populated (from the most recent, CN-aware GeT-RM CYP2D6 study); the other five target genes have published GeT-RM consensus tables too (Pratt et al. 2016) but were not transcribed into this file -- see validation/getrm_concordance_report.md for what's needed to fill them in.

CYP2D6.citation: Gaedigk A, et al. Characterization of Reference Materials for Genetic Testing of CYP2D6 Alleles: A GeT-RM Collaborative Project. J Mol Diagn. 2019. PMID:31401124

other_genes_pending.citation: Pratt VM, et al. Characterization of 137 Genomic DNA Reference Materials for 28 Pharmacogenetic Genes: A GeT-RM Collaborative Project. J Mol Diagn. 2016. PMID:26621101 (covers CYP2C9, CYP2C19, DPYD, TPMT, UGT1A1 among others -- consensus table not yet transcribed here). Corrected 2026-07: previously cited as PMID:26621017 / journal 'Genet Med', both wrong -- 26621017 is an unrelated paper, confirmed via direct PubMed fetch.
